en.title: Shortest Total Time to Visit Circular Drone Hubs in Order
en.description:
The i-th transitionTime segment connects hub i and hub i+1, and the last segment connects m and 1; every segment can be traveled in both directions. Starting from 1, visit the requested hubs in order and find the minimum total time. With these edge weights, the answer to the source example is 3, not 4.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, and judging.
en.input: The first line contains m n (1≤m≤5000, 1≤n≤200000), the second line contains m edge weights (1..1000000), and the third line contains n requested hub numbers (1..m).
en.explanation: Example 1: 1→1 takes 0, 1→3 via the last edge takes 1, 3→3 takes 0, and 3→2 takes 2, for a total of 3. Example 2: there is only one hub, so the total time is 0. Example 3: of the two routes between the two hubs, take the shorter one, 2; two round trips total 4.
hints: Prefix sums give each hub's position on the linear unrolling; the distance between consecutive requests is the smaller of the two arc lengths.
